title: The Hiker Who Was Trapped in a Forest Where the Trees Communicated
hook: The branches pointed him in circles, the roots tripped him when he tried to leave, and the leaves whispered his exact location to something that was following.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of nature being actively malevolent taps into primal fears of being hunted by the environment itself.

why_this_can_go_viral: The grotesque and specific detail of bones turning to glass creates a shocking medical mystery that viewers will want to see explained.

title: The Climber Who Reached the Summit and Saw His Own Dead Body
